summary: Web and Tauri desktop (same bundle) can send a shared verse or note into a thread. NEW FILES: frontend/src/lib/threadShare.js (canShareToThreads needs both `threads` and `chat_shared_objects`, fails closed; loadShareThreads returns the first page of the existing listThreads call capped at 10 and rejects on failure; pendingShareStatus decides wait/send/drop); frontend/src/components/ShareThreadPicker.jsx (secondary 'Main chat' + 'Thread' radio rows under the selected group, loading and retry states, no fabricated list on failure); frontend/src/hooks/useChatShare.js (the performShare + pending-share effect moved out of Reader.jsx; opens the chat, then the chosen thread, and sends once through the existing sendThreadMessage thread_message frame only after the thread's first page finished loading; thread open error or 404 drops the share with a toast and sends nothing). THIN EDITS: ShareToChatModal.jsx (+userId/threadsEnabled props, onSend(contact, thread|null)), Reader.jsx (598 -> 589 lines, hook-in and two props), useMessaging.js (sendThreadMessage now returns false when it cannot send and true otherwise, line count unchanged at 1508 so a dead socket gives a toast instead of a silent drop). ChatThread.jsx unchanged at 1815: thread rows already render via isSharedKind/SharedVerseWidget/SharedNoteCard, and note open reuses fetchSharedNote with the thread message id against the same GET route that the backend open_note now resolves with the thread grant. Wire is unchanged (minimal attachment only, no key; server rebuilds meta/text). Also tightened the chat path so a pending share waits for the chat open to return before sending (matches the documented intent). Failed thread send keeps existing behavior: server error frame drops the unacked bubble and shows the send-error toast; nothing fabricated; a failed history refresh keeps cached thread messages (untouched code). TESTS (vitest only): new src/lib/threadShare.test.js (8) and src/components/ShareToChatModal.threads.test.jsx (4) pass; related suites (SharedObjects, ChatThread.threads, GroupThreadsSection, useMessaging*) pass. Full vitest run has ~54 failures in files this change does not touch (src/*.build.test.js, seo/*, Admin* recharts, legacy js/*.test.js); not related. No vite build, no xcodebuild, no iOS Swift touched, nothing pushed or deployed. DOCS not updated here; the workflow assigns docs to step 8 once all clients land. Note for the testing gate: the Reader-level end-to-end path (useChatShare effect) is covered via pendingShareStatus unit tests, not a mounted Reader test.
